title: पञ्चाशीत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Next day the battle resumes; Parashurama looses a brahma weapon and Bhishma counters it with his own, the two weapons blazing in the sky. Bhishma then resolves to use the Prasvapa weapon, as the Brahmins had told him.
summary.kn: ಮರುದಿನ ಯುದ್ಧ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಪರಶುರಾಮನು ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಬಿಡುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಭೀಷ್ಮನು ತನ್ನದರಿಂದ ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಎರಡೂ ಅಸ್ತ್ರಗಳು ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಜ್ವಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರು ಹೇಳಿದಂತೆ ಪ್ರಸ್ವಾಪಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಬಳಸಲು ಭೀಷ್ಮನು ನಿಶ್ಚಯಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अगले दिन युद्ध फिर आरम्भ होता है; परशुराम ब्रह्मास्त्र छोड़ते हैं और भीष्म अपने ब्रह्मास्त्र से उसका प्रतिकार करते हैं, दोनों अस्त्र आकाश में जल उठते हैं। फिर भीष्म ब्राह्मणों के कहे अनुसार प्रस्वाप अस्त्र के प्रयोग का निश्चय करते हैं।
summary.te: మరుసటి రోజు యుద్ధం మళ్లీ మొదలవుతుంది; పరశురాముడు బ్రహ్మాస్త్రం విడుస్తాడు, భీష్ముడు తనదానితో ఎదుర్కొంటాడు, రెండు అస్త్రాలు ఆకాశంలో ప్రజ్వలిస్తాయి. బ్రాహ్మణులు చెప్పినట్లు ప్రస్వాపాస్త్రాన్ని ప్రయోగించాలని భీష్ముడు నిశ్చయిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: மறுநாள் போர் தொடர்கிறது; பரஶுராமர் ப்ரஹ்மாஸ்திரத்தை ஏவ, பீஷ்மர் தம்முடையதால் அதைத் தடுக்க, இரு அஸ்திரங்களும் வானில் எரிகின்றன. அந்தணர்கள் சொன்னபடி ப்ரஸ்வாப அஸ்திரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தப் பீஷ்மர் தீர்மானிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: പിറ്റേന്ന് യുദ്ധം വീണ്ടും തുടങ്ങുന്നു; പരശുരാമൻ ബ്രഹ്മാസ്ത്രം തൊടുക്കുന്നു, ഭീഷ്മർ സ്വന്തം ആയുധംകൊണ്ട് അതിനെ പ്രതിരോധിക്കുന്നു; രണ്ട് ആയുധങ്ങളും ആകാശത്ത് ജ്വലിക്കുന്നു. ബ്രാഹ്മണർ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ പ്രസ്വാപാസ്ത്രം പ്രയോഗിക്കാൻ ഭീഷ്മർ തീരുമാനിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.185; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ततो रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां प्रतिबुद्धोऽस्मि भारत ।
तं च संचिन्त्य वै स्वप्नमवापं हर्षमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, when the night had passed, O Bharata, I woke, and thinking over that dream I felt the greatest joy.

verses.text:
ततः समभवद्युद्धं मम तस्य च भारत ।
तुमुलं सर्वभूतानां लोमहर्षणमद्भुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the battle between him and me began, O Bharata, tumultuous and astonishing, making every creature's hair stand on end.

verses.text:
ततो बाणमयं वर्षं ववर्ष मयि भार्गवः ।
न्यवारयमहं तं च शरजालेन भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then the son of Bhrigu rained a shower of arrows on me, and I held it off with a net of my own arrows, O Bharata.

verses.text:
ततः परमसंक्रुद्धः पुनरेव महातपाः ।
ह्यस्तनेनैव कोपेन शक्तिं वै प्राहिणोन्मयि ॥

meaning.en: Then the great ascetic, again enraged, hurled a spear at me with the same wrath as the day before.

verses.text:
इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्शां यमदण्डोपमप्रभाम् ।
ज्वलन्तीमग्निवत्संख्ये लेलिहानां समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: It struck with the touch of Indra's thunderbolt and shone like the rod of Yama, blazing like fire in the battle and licking at everything around.

verses.text:
ततो भरतशार्दूल धिष्ण्यमाकाशगं यथा ।
सा मामभ्यहनत्तूर्णमंसदेशे च भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then, O tiger among the Bharatas, it swiftly struck me on the shoulder, like a heavenly body falling from the sky.

verses.text:
अथासृङ्मेऽस्रवद्घोरं गिरेर्गैरिकधातुवत् ।
रामेण सुमहाबाहो क्षतस्य क्षतजेक्षण ॥

meaning.en: Then, O mighty-armed one, a dreadful stream of blood flowed from me, wounded by Rama, like red mineral flowing from a mountain.

verses.text:
ततोऽहं जामदग्न्याय भृशं क्रोधसमन्वितः ।
प्रेषयं मृत्युसंकाशं बाणं सर्पविषोपमम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, filled with great anger, I sent at Jamadagni's son an arrow like death itself, like the poison of a serpent.

verses.text:
स तेनाभिहतो वीरो ललाटे द्विजसत्तमः ।
अशोभत महाराज सशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by it on the forehead, that hero, the best of Brahmins, looked like a mountain with a peak, O great king.

verses.text:
स संरब्धः समावृत्य बाणं कालान्तकोपमम् ।
संदधे बलवत्कृष्य घोरं शत्रुनिबर्हणम् ॥

meaning.en: Furious, he drew back and fitted to his bow a terrible arrow, deadly to enemies and like the Death that ends the age, drawing it back with force.

verses.text:
स वक्षसि पपातोग्रः शरो व्याल इव श्वसन् ।
महीं राजंस्ततश्चाहमगच्छं रुधिराविलः ॥

meaning.en: That fierce arrow fell on my chest, hissing like a snake; then, O king, I sank to the ground covered in blood.

verses.text:
अवाप्य तु पुनः संज्ञां जामदग्न्याय धीमते ।
प्राहिण्वं विमलां शक्तिं ज्वलन्तीमशनीमिव ॥

meaning.en: Regaining my senses, I sent a bright spear, blazing like a thunderbolt, at the wise son of Jamadagni.

verses.text:
सा तस्य द्विजमुख्यस्य निपपात भुजान्तरे ।
विह्वलश्चाभवद्राजन्वेपथुश्चैनमाविशत् ॥

meaning.en: It fell between the arms of that chief of Brahmins, and he was overcome, and a trembling seized him, O king.

verses.text:
तत एनं परिष्वज्य सखा विप्रो महातपाः ।
अकृतव्रणः शुभैर्वाक्यैराश्वासयदनेकधा ॥

meaning.en: Then his friend, the Brahmin Akritavrana, a great ascetic, embraced him and comforted him in many ways with kind words.

verses.text:
समाश्वस्तस्तदा रामः क्रोधामर्षसमन्वितः ।
प्रादुश्चक्रे तदा ब्राह्मं परमास्त्रं महाव्रतः ॥

meaning.en: Comforted, Rama of the firm vows, full of anger and wrath, then brought forth the supreme Brahma weapon.

verses.text:
ततस्तत्प्रतिघातार्थं ब्राह्ममेवास्त्रमुत्तमम् ।
मया प्रयुक्तं जज्वाल युगान्तमिव दर्शयत् ॥

meaning.en: To counter it, I launched the best of weapons, the Brahma weapon itself; it blazed as if showing the end of an age.

verses.text:
तयोर्ब्रह्मास्त्रयोरासीदन्तरा वै समागमः ।
असंप्राप्यैव रामं च मां च भारतसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: The two Brahma weapons met in mid-air, O best of the Bharatas, without reaching Rama or me.

verses.text:
ततो व्योम्नि प्रादुरभूत्तेज एव हि केवलम् ।
भूतानि चैव सर्वाणि जग्मुरार्तिं विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Then in the sky there appeared only a mass of blazing radiance, and all creatures, O lord of men, were seized with distress.

verses.text:
ऋषयश्च सगन्धर्वा देवताश्चैव भारत ।
संतापं परमं जग्मुरस्त्रतेजोभिपीडिताः ॥

meaning.en: The sages, the Gandharvas and the gods, O Bharata, were tormented by the heat of the two weapons and fell into great suffering.

verses.text:
ततश्चचाल पृथिवी सपर्वतवनद्रुमा ।
संतप्तानि च भूतानि विषादं जग्मुरुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the earth shook, with its mountains, forests and trees, and the scorched creatures sank into deep despair.

verses.text:
प्रजज्वाल नभो राजन्धूमायन्ते दिशो दश ।
न स्थातुमन्तरिक्षे च शेकुराकाशगास्तदा ॥

meaning.en: The sky blazed, O king, the ten directions smoked, and the beings that move through the air could not remain in the sky.

verses.text:
ततो हाहाकृते लोके सदेवासुरराक्षसे ।
इदमन्तरमित्येव योक्तुकामोऽस्मि भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then, as the world cried out in alarm, with its gods, demons and Rakshasas, I wished to seize that moment, O Bharata.

verses.text:
प्रस्वापमस्त्रं दयितं वचनाद्ब्रह्मवादिनाम् ।
चिन्तितं च तदस्त्रं मे मनसि प्रत्यभात्तदा ॥

meaning.en: The dear Prasvapa weapon, spoken of by the knowers of Brahman, came back to my mind and shone clear in my thought.
